capability.summary: Rank probable languages for one text string
capability.description: Runs langdetect.detect_langs on the complete input text, returns its ranked language-probability candidates as strings, and echoes only the first 60 characters of the input.
capability.problem_space: Probabilistic language identification for a single piece of plain text.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one text string; output: JSON with a 60-character text preview and ranked language candidates serialized as strings.
accepted_inputs: plain text containing enough linguistic signal for langdetect to classify
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.langdetect_detect", text as the first at most 60 characters of the input, and languages as an ordered array of stringified language-code:probability candidates. A caught language-detection exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.langdetect_detect", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: returns stringified candidates rather than structured language and probability fields
echoes only the first 60 characters even though detection uses the full input
does not set DetectorFactory.seed, so results for short or ambiguous text may vary between runs
empty or insufficient text and library detection failures are returned through the wrapper's error envelope
identifies languages only; it does not translate, segment, or classify topic or sentiment

output_contract.description: Truncated input preview plus ranked langdetect language-probability strings.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: rank likely languages for a text string
negative_intents: return a deterministic single language code
